import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Start with working directory
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && pm2 start --name areloria dist/index.js --env production 2>&1")
print("Start:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
